payload.title: Module grants never reach a decision point: the gateway copies the modules claim into a TenantContext nothing reads, the HMAC-bound verified-user assertion and the rebuilt subgraph req.user carry no module field, and the NATS caller-capability and AI chat contracts carry only roles and resourcePermissions
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/guards/tenant-isolation.guard.ts:233 (sole backend reader of the modules claim; copies it into TenantContext)
apps/gateway-api/src/federation/authenticated-data-source.ts:285-304 (assertion built from roles, assignedSiteIds and resourcePermissions only)
apps/ai-service/src/chat/ai-chat.responder.ts:29-40 (AI chat request carries userRoles and resourcePermissions only)
payload.rule_violated: Plan section 2 and PKG-04: the per-module grant is carried, integrity-protected, to every subgraph, the AI chat path and the messaging bridge; owner decision D2 cannot be enforced without it
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-04, release R1.
